svg.aria-label: Satellite style plan of the Mina Jamarat Bridge central deck section, 300 metres by 200 metres, north at the top
svg.title: Mina - Jamarat Bridge, central deck section
svg.desc: Satellite-style rendering of a 300 by 200 metre section of the Jamarat Bridge in Mina, drawn at one unit per ground metre so it aligns with the 60 by 40 cell grid. Original artwork: no third-party imagery and no map tiles. North is at the top.
